repo.description: A library for accelerating Transformer models on NVIDIA GPUs, including using 8-bit and 4-bit floating point (FP8 and FP4) precision on Hopper, Ada and Blackwell GPUs, to provide better performance with lower memory utilization in both training and inference.
repo.name: TransformerEngine

detail.body:
## Summary

FlashAttention 4 b33 adds backward support for D=256 THD attention with per-sequence length metadata on SM100/SM110. This PR selects FA4 only when the installed version supports the requested direction: b31–b32 for forward, b33+ for forward and backward. Earlier versions fall back, and deterministic D=256 backward remains excluded.

Transformer Engine uses `-1` for an unbounded attention window, while FA4 expects `None`. This PR translates that sentinel at the FA4 entry points without changing other negative window offsets.

The SM100+ L3 test lane uses FA4 b33 with CUTLASS DSL 4.8.0. It covers D=256 no-load-balance context parallelism and window handling, and runs the full backend-selection test module for FA4.

## Validation

H100 FA3 and B200 FA4 b33 L3 tests passed. The expanded B200 CP run (`NVTE_TEST_ESSENTIAL=0`) recorded 1,389 passes, 54,489 skips, and no failures. Focused reruns passed the backend-selection module and D=128/D=256 no-load-balance cases. The final test-only skip/assertion edit passed Python 3.12 compilation and `git diff --check`; it has not had another GPU run.

+def _fa4_with_none_window_sentinel(func: Callable) -> Callable:
+    """Translate TE's ``-1`` unbounded-window sentinel to FA4's ``None``.
+
+    Preserve other negative offsets, which can represent empty windows. Adapt the FA4 entry
+    points because shared FA2/FA3 callers still use ``-1``.

+
+    @functools.wraps(func)
+    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
+        window = kwargs.get("window_size")
+        if window is not None:
+            kwargs["window_size"] = tuple(None if bound == -1 else bound for bound in window)
+        for bound_name in ("window_size_left", "window_size_right"):
+            if kwargs.get(bound_name) == -1:
+                kwargs[bound_name] = None
+        return func(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    return wrapper

inline_comments.body: **D=256 Path Remains Untested** The new `cp_nlb_hdim256` configuration does not exercise the behavior it is meant to protect. Essential mode is enabled by default and filters this configuration out, including in the updated FA4 QA job. Even in the full matrix, the general test keeps `DUAL_CHUNK_SWAP`, while the dedicated `NO_LOAD_BALANCE` test still uses the D=128 `cp_2_0` configuration. As a result, the new D=256 FA4 compact-metadata forward and backward path has no regression coverage.

inline_comments.body: **Numerical Regression Coverage Removed** The FA4 lane now runs only the wrapper-level sentinel test after removing `test_fa4_causal_attention_matches_reference`. The remaining test wraps `dict.update`, so it cannot catch problems in `DotProductAttention`, backend selection, argument forwarding, or FA4 numerical behavior. This removes the only independent end-to-end numerical regression for the window adapter, allowing integration regressions in the actual causal FA4 path to go unnoticed. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

issue_comments.body:
Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium impact]** The PR appears safe to merge; no outstanding correctness, security, or repository-rule violations were identified.

Summary

This PR enables version-aware FA4 selection for SM100/SM110 D=256 THD attention and adapts Transformer Engine’s unbounded-window sentinel at FA4 entry points. - Requires FA4 b31+ for D=256 `seqused_q/k` forward and b33+ for backward. - Excludes deterministic D=256 FA4 backward where the kernel does not support it. - Updates the SM100+ L3 lane to FA4 b33 and CUTLASS DSL 4.8.0. - Adds backend-selection, sentinel-normalization, and D=256 context-parallel coverage. - The two previous review findings were resolved by adding focused D=256 no-load-balance coverage and running the complete backend-selection module in the FA4 lane.

Diagram
